description: Prometheus replica of classic DBA Overview V02 (InfluxDB hybrid). Fleet KPIs, service state, memory/CPU/disk/network.

targets.expr: count(count by (instance) (windows_service_state{job="windows_exporter", instance=~"${Host:regex}", name=~"MSSQLSERVER|MSSQL\\$.+", name!~"MSSQLFD.+|MSSQLServerOLAP.+"})) or vector(0)
count(count by (instance) (windows_service_state{job="windows_exporter", instance=~"${Host:regex}", name=~"MSOLAP.+|MSSQLServerOLAP.+"})) or vector(0)

panels.description: Volumes on U: (backup mounts). Columns: Host, Mount Point, Capacity, Free Space, Free %.
